source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-14 from the automorphism group (order 108) of the table's own CA(18;2,52,3), whose rows form 6 triples on which every column is a polynomial over F3. The group is extended to a seventh triple by a homomorphism to Z3 (programs/G21_3.gen); an exact census of all 3^21 columns (programs/orbN.c) gives three compatible orbits of sizes 36, 36 and 1, a CA(21;2,73,3); all 71194 columns compatible with these (programs/pool.c) are searched for a clique, and 23 are added (programs/clq.c, local search with fixed seed 3). programs/recipe.sh runs it; a run from scratch reproduced the array exactly (programs/recipe_log.txt). Exact check with ca_verify, all 2-sets
construction: Automorphism group of the own CA(18;2,52,3) extended to a seventh row triple, exact orbit census, then 23 columns added from the exact pool
notes: one row below the cited size 22 at k = 96; no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start
